thread:
mira: planning to flip `activation_quorum` for routing configs tonight. want to walk through approval flow + telemetry sanity checks first.
merge-bot: note: PR 14321 targets runtime/routing. pending checks: tests, lint, activation_playbook.md present
raj: requirement: two approvers from platform OR one platform + one owner. propose `quorum=2` enforced for toggles that affect routing.
paul: console UX: show a banner when activation is blocked: 'Activation blocked: approvals_needed=2'. include a link to the playbook and PR.
syl: telemetry: emit `activation_quorum`, `config_rev`, `dry_run_id` in all traces. add a `mismatch_snapshot` counter that samples 100 requests on flip.
mira: rollout plan: dry-run 1% for 20m -> compute mismatch_ratio + error delta. if mismatch_ratio < 0.5% and error_delta < 0.25% then ramp to 10% for 40m. abort thresholds strict.
tess: will own rollback. single command in runbook please.
mira: rollback command (dry-run first):
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  https://console.internal/api/configs/rollback \
  -d '{"config_name":"activation_quorum","to_rev":"rev-2026-03-18-2200"}'
```
raj: console API should refuse activation (403) unless PR metadata shows required approvals. backend will check git + review labels.
paul: adding UI toggle `require_quorum` to config edit page. if toggled, activation button greys out until backend confirms approvals. will also show a small timeline widget: who approved + when.
syl: for debug: include a `dry_run_snapshot` endpoint that returns 200 sample records with stable/candidate decisions and mismatch_reason. access restricted to authors+platform.
tess: runbook notes: include contact list, quick-monitor script, and a one-click rollback link in console. i'll add the monitor script to /ops/bin/check_quorum_flip.sh.
mira: final checklist: 1) paul: UI block + timeline, 2) raj: backend approval enforcement, 3) syl: traces + dry_run_snapshot, 4) tess: runbook + rollback ready, 5) merge-bot: block merge until playbook present.
merge-bot: PR 14321 blocked: activation_playbook.md missing
mira: i'll add playbook and ping for reviews. small ask: can we compute mismatch_ratio in under 30s? would make abort decisions faster.
syl: yes we can pre-aggregate by dry_run_id and serve a fast endpoint. will wire the chart into console.
paul: i'll add the mismatch chart under Config > routing with a quick 'compute now' button.
mira: thanks team. will post the playbook link when ready and schedule the window. ping here if you find gaps.
